card.text: TOI-561 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-561 b"
sources.quote: TOI-561 b is an ultra-short period super-Earth exoplanet orbiting TOI-561, a Sun-like star.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-561. Its orbit and size follow Piotto et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-561 b"
sources.quote: The innermost planet in its planetary system, it orbits extremely close to its star, completing an orbit within 11 hours.
